generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
DECLARATIONS: The bidder shall submit the duly signed declaration furnished in the bid document

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of Karnataka public procurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end
The original documents should be produced for verification at any stage of tender process as and when sought for, failing which, the bids are liable for disqualification
Rates shall be quoted in price schedule in the website itself
The tender document is part and parcel of the agreement Condition
Conditional tenders are liable for rejection
The successful bidder shall give an undertaking that they would abide by the provisions of the Employees Provident Fund Act.
The bidder shall obtain insurance coverage for all the workers deployed for this work

The bidder shall quote his rates exclusive of GST but inclusive of all other applicable taxes, levies, duties and Building Workers Welfare Cess at 1% etc., as per the latest GoK and GoI prevailing as on the last date of submission of bid
The bidder shall quote his rates inclusive of PF as per the applicable rate as issued by the PF department from time to time
KPCL shall recover the Income Tax, building workers welfare cess, at the prevailing applicable rates

The bidder should take into account the prevailing royalty charges while quoting their rates. The successful bidder shall strictly adhere goK circular no. 7.11.2023) to Rule 36 & 42 of Karnataka Mineral Concession Rules 1994 & its amendments thereof. If the successful bidder/agency fails to furnish documents related to remittance of royalty charges for Coarse aggregate, Fine aggregate, murrum etc., as per Rule 44(4) of Karnataka Mineral Concession (amendment) Rules 2023, revailing royalty charges along with following penalty will be recovered from the work bills.a)A penalty of 5 times the royalty amount & additional payment (AP) of 40% royalty amount to Department of mines and Geology.b)A penalty of 10% of royalty amount and the same will be transferred to District Mineral Foundation Trust

The bidder should maintain register of workers deployed and wages paid for the workers and shall produce the documents whenever called for by the competent authority. Remittance towards PF shall be commensurate with the labour component of the work involved
Bidder should have independent PF code. The bidder shall remit PF of labourers to Contractors permanent PF code number only and not to the KPCL PF sub code
In case the dates notified above declared as holiday, the immediate next working day will be reckoned
If the Bidder makes any alterations in the conditions of the contract or puts any condition of his own, such tenders are liable for rejection

The bidder shall register himself under section 7 and their workers who will be engaged for the works under section 12 of the Building and other construction workers (Regulation of employment & conditions of services) Act 1996
The bidder shall quote item rates on the basis of prevailing market rate

Bidders shall give declaration regarding payment of fair and reasonable wages which shall not be less than the minimum wages fixed by the government from time to time to the labours working under the contractor in the contract undertaken by him. Failing which, the bids are liable for rejection

The successful bidder shall make payment of fair and reasonable wages which shall not be less than the minimum wages fixed by the Government of Karnataka from time to time to the labours working under the contractor in the contract undertaken by him
Any variation in labour wages made by the Government from time to time shall be borne by the agency. Any claim towards this variation will not be entertained by KPCL
The successful bidder shall obtain ESI coverage for all the workers deployed for this work if required

KPCL reserves the right to verify any information/document furnished by the bidder should the circumstances so warrant in the overall interest of the Corporation. In case the information or the documents furnished are found to be incorrect or invalid, then tenders of such bidders will be cancelled and the EMD furnished by such bidders will be forfeited
Any revision in GST rates during execution of work will be paid to the contractor by KPCL or recovered from the bills of contractor

In case of death of a contractor after executing the agreement/ commencement of the work, his legal heir (to be intimated at the time of execution of agreement by the successful contractor), if any eligible registered contractor and willing, can execute and complete the work at the accepted tender rates irrespective of the cost of the work after obtaining approval from competent authority

The successful bidder shall furnish Contract performance guarantee (CPG)/Security deposit (SD) in the form of DD/NEFT or e-Bank Guarantee from any schedule bank acceptable to the Corporation, Insurance Surety Bonds issued by Insurance Company authorized by Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India within 20 days of receipt of Letter of Intent through KPPP
Contract performance guarantee (CPG)/Security deposit (SD) shall be equivalent to 5% of the Contract amount and should be valid for 30 days after the date of completion of defect liability period

Work completion period is 02(Two) calendar Months excluding Monsoon. Defect liability period for the work is 120 months from the date of completion of work. Contract period is 122 months (i.e Work completion period plus Defect liability period
If tenderer has engaged in corrupt or fraudulent practice, action shall be initiated finance department, Government of Karnataka Notification No.FD884 Exp-12/2019, Bengaluru, dated 7th May 2020
Power supply will be provided at free of cost wherever available. Otherwise agency has to make necessary arrangements at his own cost
Corrigendum/modification/corrections, if any, will be published in the web site only

Further details of the work or any clarifications can be obtained from the office of the Executive Engineer (Civil) Hosangadi, Kundapura Tq , Udupi District -576282 during office hours. Mobile-9449598843

technicalCriterionList.description: The intending bidder should have satisfactorily completed (at least 90% of the contract value) as a prime contractor at least one Water proofing treatment work using TPO membrane of value not less than Rs. 6.32 Lakhs during the preceding five financial years (i.e., 2021-22,2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26). The past experience should be supported by original scanned copy of the Work done certificate issued from state/central Government/Government under taking from the officers not below the rank of Executive Engineer. (Work done of previous financial years shall be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the price level of the financial year in which the tender is invited).
List of existing commitments and ongoing work

Eligible Tenderers will be qualified only if their available tender capacity is more than the total tender value. The available tender capacity will be calculated as under:Assessed available tender capacity (A x N x 2.5 - B)where A Maximum value of works executed in any one year during the last five years (updated to 2026-27 price level) taking into account the completed as well as works in progress.N Number of years prescribed for completion of the works for which tenders are invited 0.167 years.B :Value, at 2026-27 price level, of existing commitments and on-going works to be completed during the next 0.167years (period of completion of the works for which Tenders are invited)

itemList.description: External sweeping and terrace cleaning - Cleaning of outer periphery like roads footpaths curb stones terrace including removing grass dust etc.,to the nearest garbage pit using suitable coconut roomstic, bombay broomstick, squezers /wipers /rubberbrush complete and as directed by Engineer in charge. ---- In accordance with finance department circular No FD 417EXP-12/2024, dated 09.08.2024, bidders are required to submit the financial quotes excluding GST

Surface preperation: Removing loose particles, previous treatments if any etc, cleaning with wire brush or mechanical mean completely. Opening the cracks if any by making V groove all along the surface concrete cracks and coving b/w the floor and wall joint surface. Cleaning and sealing the same with polymer morter (1:3) admixed with SBR latex at 1.5 Kg/50 kg cement, pressure grouting, wherever necessary, providing and applying ready mix polymer mortar by trowel to get neat surface wherever necessary, Completeing the work including cost of material labour HOM and transpotation etc, with all lead and lifts, Complete as per specifications and as directed by the engineer-in-charge. ---- In accordance with finance department circular No FD 417EXP-12/2024, dated 09.08.2024, bidders are required to submit the financial quotes excluding GST

Providing and installing,TPO single side Fleece back Membrane, Membrane shall be high performance, heat weldable, thermoplastic polyolefin (TPO) sheet, manufactured & supplied in specified thickness of 1.2mm,designed for waterproofing and heat shielding roofs of new and existing buildings ,with puncture resistance of 57 LBF- ASTM D 751, breaking Strength 125 LBF- ASTM D751, tear strength 30 LBF - ASTM D 751 procedure B,high peel strength of seam joints and heat welds, Chlorine free, plasticizer free, phthalate free. Environmentally friendly and safe for humans, Exceptional resistance to heat, UV, Ozone, bacteria, chemical, acid corrosion,Resistance to root penetration, suitable for green roofs, Continuous serviceability from -30 degree C to 100 dregree C Single side TPO membrane, without cracking, tearing or brittleness failure, 100% recyclable. Shall be applied over the well prepared surface by applying cementitious adhesive for the roof, high performance adhesive over the wall surface and at back side of the supported with mechanical anchors ,lapping of membrane for width of 75mm by hot air welding including grinding sharp edges at the substrate, cleaning the substrate to make them free from all contaminants, pretreating all the pipe penetrations by installing a layer of Single side Fleece membrane; Approved by CFTRI, etc., complete with all lead and lifts., Complete as per specifications etc., and as directed by the engineer-in-charge ---- In accordance with finance department circular No FD 417EXP-12/2024, dated 09.08.2024, bidders are required to submit the financial quotes excluding GST

Providing and Applying PU based Elastomeric Liquid Applied PU Waterproofing Membrane single component, cold applied, water based acrylic PU dispersion with highly elastic and UV resistant water proofing treatment to the Existing Roof surface/Chajjas/Sunken portion of WC:Bathroom applied @ 1.2 l/per m2, having tensile strength greater than 1.5N/mm2, elongation greater than 300% with solid content not less than 60% in 2 coats including surface preparation, priming the surface with water based acrylic primer @0.1 l/m2, and spreading 60 gsm geotextile between two top coats completely as per specification. The finished cost to include surface preparation, making coving at Junction, Bore Packing, treatment of construction joints completely as per specification. ---- In accordance with finance department circular No FD 417EXP-12/2024, dated 09.08.2024, bidders are required to submit the financial quotes excluding GST
